# RepairShopr

RepairShopr is a comprehensive repair shop management software designed to streamline operations, manage customer relationships, and enhance business efficiency.

Category: Sales & CRM. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/repairshopr/.

## Actions

- **Add Product Photo**: Add photo(s) to a specific product.
- **Create Appointment**: Create a new appointment.
- **Create Asset**: Create a new asset.
- **Create Customer**: Create a new customer.
- **Create Estimate**: Create a new estimate.
- **Create Invoice**: Create a new invoice.
- **Create Lead**: Create a new lead.
- **Create Payment**: Create a new payment.
- **Create Product**: Create a new product in inventory.
- **Delete Appointment**: Delete a specific appointment by its id.
- **Delete Customer**: Delete a specific customer by id.
- **Delete Estimate**: Delete a specific estimate by id.
- **Delete Invoice**: Delete a specific invoice by id.
- **Get Appointment**: Retrieve details of a specific appointment by its id.
- **Get Appointments**: Retrieve a list of appointments.
- **Get Asset**: Retrieve details of a specific asset by its id.
- **Get Assets**: Retrieve a paginated list of assets.
- **Get Case Attachments**: Retrieve attachments for a specific service case.
- **Get Contacts**: Retrieve a paginated list of contacts.
- **Get Customer**: Retrieve details of a specific customer by id.
- **Get Customers**: Retrieve a list of customers.
- **Get Employee Time Clock**: Retrieve the last time clock entry for a specific user.
- **Get Estimate**: Retrieve details of a specific estimate by id.
- **Get Estimates**: Retrieve a list of estimates.
- **Get Invoice**: Retrieve details of a specific invoice by id.
- **Get Invoices**: Retrieve a paginated list of invoices.
- **Get Lead**: Retrieve details of a specific lead by its id.
- **Get Leads**: Retrieve a paginated list of leads.
- **Get Payment**: Retrieve details of a specific payment by id.
- **Get Payments**: Retrieve a paginated list of payments.
- **Get Product**: Retrieve details of a specific product by id.
- **Get Product Categories**: Retrieve product categories.
- **Get Product Serials**: Retrieve all serial numbers for a specific product.
- **Get Products**: Retrieve a list of products.
- **Get Products By Category**: Retrieve products filtered by category id.
- **Get Ticket**: Retrieve details of a specific ticket by its id.
- **Get User**: Retrieve details of a specific user by id.
- **Get Users**: Retrieve a list of all users.
